summary: Mark static board note text blocks for picture export

entries.summary: Add `data-board-text`, `flow-root`, and card `border-box` sizing to `BoardNoteElementStatic` in `board-static.tsx`, so exported board pictures measure grown notes and draw their text and bound arrows whole.
migrationNotes: Update `platejs` and copy the `board` registry item again (or add `data-board-text=""` and `flow-root` to `BoardNoteElementStatic`'s text wrapper and `boxSizing: 'border-box'` to its card in `board-static.tsx`) so exported board pictures measure and draw grown notes whole.
